nodes.name: Webhook - Receive Multiple Images
nodes.notes:
Receives multiple product packaging images via POST request.

Expected payload: FormData with image0, image1, image2, etc.

Supports 1-5 images per request.

nodes.name: Extract Images from FormData
nodes.notes:
Extracts all images from FormData (image0, image1, etc.).

Validates:
- At least 1 image exists
- Maximum 5 images

Outputs array of images with metadata (index, name, type, size).

parameters.text:
Analyze this product packaging image and extract the following information for this consumable item:

  - Product Name (full name including brand)
  - Brand (manufacturer/brand name separately, e.g., "Britannia", "Parle", "Amul")
  - Category (main product type: Snacks, Beverages, Dairy, Bakery, Confectionery, Frozen Foods, Ready to Eat, Condiments, etc.)
  - Sub-category (specific type: Biscuits, Chips, Cookies, Chocolates, Juice, Milk, Cheese, Bread, etc.)
  - Expiry Date (format as YYYY-MM-DD, look for "Best Before", "Exp Date", "Use By")
  - MRP (Maximum Retail Price with currency symbol)
  - Weight/Quantity (with unit like g, kg, ml, L)
  - Ingredients (complete comma-separated list)
  - Nutritional Information (key nutrients per 100g/100ml: Energy/Calories, Protein, Carbohydrates, Total Sugar, Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, Sodium, Fiber)

  IMPORTANT: Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting or code blocks.

  JSON format:
  {
    "productName": "string",
    "brand": "string",
    "category": "string",
    "subCategory": "string",
    "expiryDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
    "mrp": "string with currency",
    "weight": "string with unit",
    "ingredients": "comma-separated string",
    "nutrition": {
      "energyKcal": number,
      "proteinG": number,
      "carbsG": number,
      "sugarG": number,
      "fatG": number,
      "saturatedFatG": number,
      "transFatG": number,
      "sodiumMg": number,
      "fiberG": number
    }
  }

nodes.name: Gemini Vision API
nodes.notes:
Processes each image through Gemini Vision API.

Uses same prompt as single-image workflow.

Handles rate limiting via sequential processing.

nodes.name: Parse Single Image Response
nodes.notes:
Parses each Gemini response individually.

Handles:
- JSON extraction and cleanup
- Error handling (graceful failure)
- Metadata tagging (_imageIndex, _imageName, _extractionSuccess)

Failed images don't stop the workflow.

nodes.name: Merge Results
nodes.notes:
CRITICAL: Intelligent merging of all image results.

Strategies:
- Product name/brand: LONGEST (most descriptive)
- Category/weight: MOST FREQUENT (voting)
- Expiry date: EARLIEST (safety first)
- MRP: HIGHEST
- Ingredients: DEDUPLICATE and merge
- Nutrition: AVERAGE non-null values

Calculates confidence based on field agreement across images.

nodes.name: Calculate Days to Expire
nodes.notes:
Same logic as single-image workflow.

Calculates expiry in human-readable format with status.

nodes.name: Analyze Health Rating
nodes.notes:
Same logic as single-image workflow.

Analyzes health rating based on merged ingredients and nutrition data.

nodes.name: Respond with Analysis Results
nodes.notes:
Returns analyzed product data to web app WITHOUT saving to database.

User can review and edit the information before saving.
